title: Captions and words keep clear of the mark on every layout, STAGE included
goal:
Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-15): "keep captions clear of the mark". On every layout, full-screen STAGE included, the mark stays as it is and every caption, title and word is placed outside its clear zone. Third attempt: do not reuse branch ve-card/ve-motion-2-mark-clearance (it only measured overlap, failed 11 of its own 20 tests and walked a 9:16 mark that is no longer drawn).

Where the mark is: config/brand-palette.json formats is the source. long_cut (16:9) body.icon is "tile"; short_cut (9:16) body.icon is false, so 9:16 has no mark zone. If a format's body.icon becomes truthy, the same code and tests must cover it with no edit.

1. geometry.ts: export markZone(aspect) -> Box | null. 16:9: the union of every top-left mark box BrandFrame draws (MarkTile's boxFor('mark') and, on an ink STAGE beat, StageHeader's logo box; export StageHeader's LOGO numbers, never copy them), each grown right and down by its 10 px shadow and by 24 px on every side. 9:16: null. Never change the mark's position, size, image, shadow or colour, and never hide it on any layout.
2. Move the words, not the mark. Every caption or title box that intersects markZone moves down so its top is markZone's bottom, keeping its left, width and centring. Known offenders: HeldTitle wide (titleTop 120, WordCaption.tsx) and captions/kit.ts REGIONS['16:9'].upper (top 108). Read the zone, never hard-code the new top. Boxes that already clear it stay byte-identical.
3. layouts/index.ts: export textSafe(layout, aspect): slotsFor's boxes with any part inside markZone cut off from the top, so STAGE and WINDOW keep their full-bleed picture slot while words get a box below the zone. Do not move FWP_SPLIT_SEAM_Y or any slot's top.
4. The channel pill is the mark's own lockup (palette body.series_pill) and is exempt; the EndingBand close is exempt (it covers the frame and carries its own marks).
5. qc_composition.composition_checks: a mark_clearance row on every beat of a 16:9 cut (and of any aspect whose format's body.icon is truthy; otherwise applies false with the palette reason). (a) geometry: every caption page box (qc_faces.caption_box) and every non-full-bleed used slot against the zone parsed from the renderer files; (b) pixels: OCR the zone minus the mark boxes at the beat's key frame with the module's _words; any word fails. The row lists each offender and its overlap in px.
read: apps/renderer/src/engine/**, apps/renderer/src/house/**, config/brand-palette.json, scripts/velib/qc.py, scripts/velib/qc_faces.py, scripts/velib/qc_composition.py, docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md, docs/ve/INGREDIENTS.md
contract:
Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. The standard is docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md (rule 3, the mark).

Tests that must pass only when the rule holds. mark-clearance.test.ts: for both aspects, every layout, every caption placement (band() lower, centre, upper), the house caption (boxFor('caption')), WordCaption's word, split and graphics boxes, HeldTitle, leadBox, ArtDirectedCaption's box and echo and CallCard, no box intersects markZone (0 px overlap); textSafe never intersects it and STAGE's picture slot is still full bleed; boxFor('mark','16:9') and StageHeader's logo are unchanged from main; no slotsFor top changed; markZone('9:16') is null and the test reads config/brand-palette.json to prove both aspects match its body.icon; a box 1 px inside the zone gives 1, one touching its edge gives 0. tests/ve_mark_clearance_test.py: a synthetic 16:9 STAGE beat with a caption page under the mark fails mark_clearance, the real layouts pass, a 9:16 cut gives applies false naming the palette.
